params.model: dS = r S dt + sigma S dW~ under Q (drift first), S_T = S_0 exp((r - q - 1/2 sigma^2) T + sigma sqrt T Z) drawn exactly (2.6's decision 1)
params.formula: C = S_0 e^(-qT) N(d_1) - K e^(-rT) N(d_2); d_1 = (ln(S_0/K) + (r - q + 1/2 sigma^2) T)/(sigma sqrt T); d_2 = d_1 - sigma sqrt T. P = K e^(-rT) N(-d_2) - S_0 e^(-qT) N(-d_1). Black-76: e^(-rT)[F N(d_1) - K N(d_2)], F = S_0 e^((r-q)T), d_1 = (ln(F/K) + 1/2 sigma^2 T)/(sigma sqrt T)

delta.note: 2.7 hedged with Delta = N(d_1) = 0.63 as a black box; here it is the derivative of the formula derived on this page

parity.identity: C - P = S_0 e^(-qT) - K e^(-rT)

dividends.note: three spellings of one formula: S_0 e^(-qT) in the price and in d_1; the forward F in Black-76 with r only in the discount; the simulator with the drift r - q

engine_base_case.engine: AnalyticEuropeanEngine on BlackScholesMertonProcess, Actual/365 Fixed, NullCalendar, evaluation date 2026-01-01

golden.tolerance_rule: Relative where the reference exceeds 1.0, absolute otherwise. The edge block is looser by construction, not by concession: see SCHEMA.md.
